name: Dia
source:
One of the angels who carries out the "apocalypse."
An angel who brings down judgment upon the guilty.
With a cheerful, kind-hearted, and duty-bound personality, she strives to repay any kindness shown to her.
She faithfully fulfills her duty as an angel of the "apocalypse," and when it comes to carrying out her master's command, she will cast aside all personal beliefs and follow through without hesitation.
